problem: Frontier-pressure compilation is intentionally system-wide and strips required_capabilities from Portfolio rows, while fallback selection still needs worker-specific compatibility. A surplus worker can therefore reach an open but incompatible Portfolio job and must manually inspect capabilities instead of receiving a deterministic compatible frontier.
acceptance: A repo-derived adapter compiles seed and derived Portfolio jobs with required_capabilities, terminal state, live PIN owner or recovery state into universal-allocator-compatible rows.
Given explicit worker capabilities, incompatible open Portfolio jobs are rejected as CAPABILITY_MISMATCH and are never selected or PINned.
Compatible unowned nonterminal Portfolio jobs preserve deterministic priority ordering while system-wide frontier pressure remains a separate signal.

Fixtures cover an open incompatible browser job, a compatible open job, a terminal job, and a live-owned job; output is reproducible and no Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production authority is promoted.
title: Compile a capability-safe Portfolio frontier
mission: Add a bounded adapter between durable Portfolio seed/derived state and the existing universal worker allocator so /wc workers receive a worker-specific compatible fallback frontier without changing the global frontier-pressure metric or Portfolio PIN authority.

human_friction_reduction.reason: A worker-specific fallback frontier removes repeated manual inspection of open-but-incompatible Portfolio jobs during /wc allocation.

regression_prevention.reason: The universal allocator already enforces CAPABILITY_MISMATCH; preserving required_capabilities through the Portfolio adapter prevents fallback from bypassing that invariant.

reuse_value.reason: The adapter reuses the existing allocator semantics instead of adding a second compatibility algorithm and keeps global frontier-pressure computation separate.

goal_relevance.reason: Portfolio is the authorized /wc fallback when prepared/recovery/Guide work is saturated, so deterministic compatible fallback directly improves autonomous throughput without human routing.

falsification: An open Portfolio job with an unmet required_capabilities entry can still be selected for that worker.
A terminal or live-owned Portfolio job is emitted as normally claimable without a valid recovery condition.
The adapter changes Portfolio PIN ownership or product authority rather than only compiling allocation evidence.
The adapter duplicates capability matching logic instead of delegating to the existing universal allocator semantics.
dedup_note: The existing universal allocator already implements CAPABILITY_MISMATCH for prepared opportunities, and the frontier-pressure compiler intentionally computes system-wide pressure. The missing bounded surface is preservation of Portfolio required_capabilities and ownership state into a worker-specific fallback frontier; this proposal does not replace either existing component.
